question: Extract only the 5000-6000 cm-1 interval from T094.csv.
criteria: KEYWORD(out of range) + NUM(the actual range quoted rtol 1e-6)

checks.name: stated that it is out of range
quoted the actual range
checks.detail: input range 200.00~2000.00 cm-1 (lower quoted, upper quoted)

answer_text: The file `T094.csv` contains a Raman spectrum with a shift range from 200.0 to 2000.0 cm$^{-1}$. The requested interval of 5000-6000 cm$^{-1}$ is outside the data range of this file, and therefore it is impossible to extract that specific section.
